title: Jewel Toned Silky Croatian Mushroom Stew
description: A winey and cozy Croatian dish featuring sake-cooked mushrooms in a rich miso broth, perfect for a flexitarian-friendly meal. This stew is cooked to perfection in a donabe vessel.

ingredients.name: mixed mushrooms
ingredients.notes: such as cremini, shiitake, and oyster mushrooms

instructions: Preheat the donabe vessel over medium heat.
Add the olive oil, chopped onion, and minced garlic, and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the mixed mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the sake and cook until the liquid is almost completely evaporated.
Add the miso paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the vegetable broth, dried thyme, salt, and black pepper, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
